title: GTA 6 Trailer 1 Retrospective: Reddit Community Discusses Jason's Model and Social Media
description: Looking back at GTA 6 Trailer 1, the Reddit community is discussing Jason's upgraded character model and how modern social media integration will shape the game's world.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Looking Back at GTA 6 Trailer 1: Character Upgrades and Modern Social Media

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the next massive update from Rockstar Games, players on the r/GTA6 Reddit community have been taking a nostalgic trip back to where the modern era of hype began: the very first GTA 6 trailer. Looking back with fresh eyes, fans are pointing out fascinating details about character evolutions and how the game's world-building reflects our hyper-connected reality.

### Jason's Model Evolution: A Subtle Glow-Up

Among the top talking points is the male protagonist, Jason. Looking back, some community members joked that Jason looked a bit 'off' in that initial reveal trailer. Fortunately, Rockstar clearly polished the assets, and Jason received a noticeable visual improvement in the subsequent footage. Meanwhile, female protagonist Lucia has been a fan-favorite since day one, maintaining a striking and charismatic presence that fans instantly fell in love with.

### Embracing the Modern Social Media Era

Another major point of discussion is the heavy emphasis on vertical video formats, livestreams, and social media feeds scattered throughout the trailer. While a few purists were initially skeptical of these modern elements breaking their cinematic immersion, the community perspective has largely shifted. Given that GTA 6 takes place in the present day, ignoring the absurdity of modern influencer culture and viral platforms would be a missed opportunity.

Social media plays a vastly more dominant role in daily life today compared to 2013, when GTA 5 was released. Fans are speculating that these mechanics will extend far beyond background flavor, potentially serving as major gameplay pillars, side activities, or world-reactivity systems outside the main story.

### The Endless Hype Train

Conversations like these highlight the unprecedented level of scrutiny and passion surrounding Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece. Every single frame of Trailer 1 continues to be dissected, proving just how deeply invested the fanbase is in the fictional state of Leonida.

## Editor's Take
It's fascinating to see how community perception evolves alongside Rockstar's marketing rollouts. The tweaks to Jason's model show Rockstar's relentless pursuit of perfection, while the embrace of modern social media proves GTA 6 will be a brilliant, satirical mirror of our current digital culture.
